proposition: The Turka family had been noted for its scholars since Ilkhanid times; Ibn Turka himself states its distinguished seven-century history, and an ancestor is said to have come from Khujand to Isfahan in the Khwarazmshahid/Seljuq period.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (1431-32), addressed to Bāysunghur
mediation.note: written to seek intercession from the ruler's son while his case was still unresolved
the family's own account; MK says information before the 8th/14th century is lost
